Screening location: Northwest Film Forum – 1515 12th Ave, Seattle

A rare double feature of pioneering media artist and filmmaker Shu Lea Cheang’s 90-minute director’s cut of I.K.U. and its seldom-screened 2023 follow-up UKI, co-presented by SECS Fest! Known for her groundbreaking and transgressive works including the cyberfeminist classic Fresh Kill (newly added to the Criterion Collection), Cheang has long challenged boundaries of genre, identity, and technology.

First, in I.K.U. Shu Lea Cheang probes the commodification of pleasure—and explores the seamier implications of Blade Runner—in the tale of Reiko, a robot programmed to accumulate sexual experience for a corporation in New Tokyo. Reiko morphs through seven body types to experience a variety of couplings, then returns to the company to download her accumulated “orgasm data”—and to escape from their control.
